SELECT DISTINCT e.FIRST_NAME || ' ' || e.LAST_NAME AS employee_name, c.COUNTRY_NAME
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON d.MANAGER_ID = e.EMPLOYEE_ID
JOIN locations l ON d.LOCATION_ID = l.LOCATION_ID
JOIN countries c ON l.COUNTRY_ID = c.COUNTRY_ID;

INNER JOIN countries c ON l.COUNTRY_ID = c.COUNTRY_ID

LEFT JOIN employees m ON e.MANAGER_ID = m.EMPLOYEE_ID
ORDER BY e.HIRE_DATE;

FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id
JOIN locations l ON d.location_id = l.location_id
JOIN countries c ON l.country_id = c.country_id
JOIN regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id
JOIN jobs j ON e.job_id = j.job_id
WHERE j.job_title LIKE '%ACCOUNT%'
  AND e.commission_pct IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_name
ORDER BY MAX(e.commission_pct) DESC;

       r.region_name

LEFT JOIN departments d        ON e.department_id = d.department_id
LEFT JOIN locations   l        ON d.location_id   = l.location_id
LEFT JOIN countries   c        ON l.country_id    = c.country_id
LEFT JOIN regions     r        ON c.region_id     = r.region_id;

WITH emp_region AS (
    SELECT e.EMPLOYEE_ID,
           e.FIRST_NAME,
           e.LAST_NAME,
           e.MANAGER_ID,
           r.REGION_ID
    FROM employees e
    LEFT JOIN departments d ON e.DEPARTMENT_ID = d.DEPARTMENT_ID
    LEFT JOIN locations l ON d.LOCATION_ID = l.LOCATION_ID
    LEFT JOIN countries c ON l.COUNTRY_ID = c.COUNTRY_ID
    LEFT JOIN regions r ON c.REGION_ID = r.REGION_ID
    WHERE e.MANAGER_ID IS NULL OR e.MANAGER_ID = 0
),
region_head AS (
    SELECT REGION_ID,
           MIN(EMPLOYEE_ID) AS HEAD_EMPLOYEE_ID
    FROM emp_region
    GROUP BY REGION_ID
)
SELECT er.FIRST_NAME || ' ' || er.LAST_NAME AS employee_name
FROM region_head rh
JOIN emp_region er ON rh.HEAD_EMPLOYEE_ID = er.EMPLOYEE_ID AND rh.REGION_ID = er.REGION_ID;

    JOIN departments d ON jh.DEPARTMENT_ID = d.DEPARTMENT_ID
    JOIN locations l ON d.LOCATION_ID = l.LOCATION_ID

INNER JOIN countries c ON l.COUNTRY_ID = c.COUNTRY_ID

GROUP BY r.REGION_ID, r.REGION_NAME
